Some phones, e.g. from Motorola, also use a light sensor next to the rear cameras for adaptive brightness. The flashlight blinds it and the screen jumps to full brightness. While the flashlight is on, this app pauses adaptive brightness and sets the brightness itself from the front sensor only, using your system\'s own brightness curve. When the flashlight turns off, adaptive brightness and your previous setting are restored.
